##### Project general facts

DAMAC Majestine is a luxury residential development located in the heart of Business Bay, one of Dubai’s most prominent mixed-use districts. The project offers a collection of furnished studios as well as one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, designed to combine contemporary elegance with the convenience of urban living. Positioned close to Downtown Dubai and key business destinations, DAMAC Majestine provides residents with a prestigious address and easy access to the city’s commercial, retail, and entertainment hubs.

The development is designed to deliver a premium lifestyle experience supported by a range of resident-focused amenities and services. Residents can enjoy facilities such as swimming pools, fitness areas, landscaped spaces, and concierge services, all contributing to a comfortable and well-rounded living environment. The project also places a strong emphasis on privacy, security, and convenience, making it suitable for both end-users and investors seeking a high-quality residential offering in a central location.

The interiors feature thoughtfully planned layouts with expertly designed living spaces finished to a high standard. Residences are completed with premium-quality finishes, refined fittings, and elegant furnishings that enhance the overall sense of luxury. Kitchens are fully equipped with modern appliances, while all apartments are delivered fully furnished, creating a move-in-ready living environment that combines sophistication, comfort, and practicality.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai’s thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces.

Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water.

As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living — all in one prime location.
